name: Slovakia

authorities.competent_authority: ŠÚKL (Štátny ústav pre kontrolu liečiv, State Institute for Drug Control).
authorities.ethics: One national Ethics Committee established by the Ministry of Health assesses Part II for CTIS medicinal-product trials. Separate institutional ethics review may still be relevant to local governance but does not replace the national CTIS Part II assessment.
authorities.fee: Not stated in the Slovakia guides (DECISIONS.md, Missing).
authorities.national_guidance: Act No. 362/2011 Coll. on medicinal products and medical devices (sections 29a and 29h); Act No. 576/2004 Coll. (section 6); ŠÚKL Good Clinical Practice for investigators (section 4.8); ŠÚKL Annual Report 2025 (consent-document deficiencies: missing Ethics Committee telephone details and travel-cost information); Slovakia section of the Commission's Overview of Part II requirements per Member State (accessed 31 August 2026).

answer_languages_note: One package language. Part II forms are answered in Slovak (matching the supplied Slovak variable sheet); K1 and M1 may also be bilingual Slovak and English. English versions of patient-facing documents, if submitted, are companions of the Slovak documents (DECISIONS.md D1).

language_rules.rule: Slovak law requires the application dossier and participant documentation to be submitted in Slovak (Act No. 362/2011 Coll., section 29a(9)). Translate the approved meaning, not only the words; medical terms, withdrawal language, data-protection rights and contact information stay understandable to the intended population.
language_rules.english_versions: National guidance expects submitted patient-facing documents in English and Slovak. Keep the English master and the Slovak translation synchronised by version and date and aligned in meaning; the Slovak version is the participant-use version. If only a Slovak participant version is legally needed for an item, keep a certified or documented translation trail in the sponsor file (DECISIONS.md D1).

bilingual_allowed.SK-K1: Slovak or bilingual Slovak and English

language_rules.form_answers: Shared EU forms (content/eu/templates/part-ii) are answered in Slovak.

study_facts_country_specific.compensation.fully_stated_in_participant: Are payments, expenses, compensation and other financial arrangements already stated clearly in the Participant Information Sheet? (P1 trigger)
study_facts_country_specific.trial.gmo: Does the trial involve genetically modified organisms? (additional authorisation, Act No. 362/2011 Coll.)
study_facts_country_specific.radiation.investigational_radioactive_pr: Is there planned exposure involving investigational radioactive medicinal products or precursors? (additional authorisation)
study_facts_country_specific.sites.organ_tissue_cell_removal_or_trans: Does a site remove or transplant human organs, tissues or cells as part of the trial? (transplant-centre authorisation)
study_facts_country_specific.population.persons_in_custody: Would the protocol enrol people in custody, serving a prison sentence or held in detention? Prohibited in Slovakia: must be false; raise a finding if the protocol allows it.

documents.language_rule: Slovak, or bilingual Slovak and English.

template.basis: EudraLex Volume 10 recruitment and informed-consent procedure template, version 2.0 (applies to new Part II submissions from 1 September 2026); the procedure content is required and the exact EudraLex form is highly recommended for Slovakia (Commission Member State overview)

documents.content: How candidates are identified, approached, informed, given time to decide and consented; any use of treating physicians, databases, referrals, advertisements, remote steps or legal representatives. Complete the Member State fields for Slovakia. Every population pathway in the plan (minors with justified age bands, adults unable to consent, impartial witness and oral consent, emergency) needs its section completed.

national_fields.v105: Required in Slovakia: in Slovak, state that each recruitment advertisement or invitation used in Slovakia is submitted under Recruitment arrangements in its final Slovak wording before use, with non-text formats described clearly; that recruitment material contains no promotional claims, guaranteed benefit or wording that could create undue influence; and, for healthy volunteers, how they are identified and screened, including databases or recruitment vendors. State that persons in custody, serving a prison sentence or held in detention are not recruited (Act No. 362/2011 Coll.).
national_fields.v108: Required in Slovakia: in Slovak, state that participant documents are provided in Slovak (the Slovak version is the participant-use version); that the participant receives the information before signing and has enough time and opportunity to ask questions; that the participant or legal representative and the person conducting the consent discussion sign and personally date the approved form before any trial-specific procedure (blank and unsigned in CTIS) and that the participant receives a copy of the signed and dated form; that forms are not predated, optional choices are not completed on the participant's behalf and no later translation is used without ethics approval; and that the consent discussion is documented in the source record.
national_fields.v110: Required in Slovakia when adults unable to consent are included: in Slovak, describe who assesses capacity, when it is reassessed and how the result is documented (diagnosis, age, hospitalisation or disability alone do not prove incapacity); how the legally designated representative under Slovak law is identified and how their authority is verified before enrolment and retained in the site file (a caregiver or family member is not automatically the legal representative); the participant information suited to the participant's understanding and how assent is recorded; that an explicit objection of a participant who can form an opinion is respected; that the views of the person unable to consent are recorded (Act No. 576/2004 Coll.); and the participant's own consent when capacity is regained.
national_fields.v114: Required in Slovakia when minors are included: in Slovak, explain and justify the age and understanding bands and their documents (Slovak national guidance identifies a separate set for ages 12 to 18; capacity to understand is assessed individually); whose permission is obtained in each family situation under Slovak law and how legal authority is verified, including when two representatives sign and the legal basis where one signature is proposed; how the investigator checks whether the child can form a view; how assent and dissent are obtained and recorded (verbal assent recorded where a written form is not suitable); that explicit refusal or later dissent of a minor capable of forming an opinion is respected; and the participant's own consent with the approved adult form on turning 18.
national_fields.v117: Required in Slovakia when an impartial witness may be needed: in Slovak, state that a witness is used when the participant or representative cannot read the information; that a participant who understands and can consent but cannot write gives oral consent entered into a record signed by at least one witness (Slovak law); that the witness is independent of the trial, understands the language and is present for the whole discussion, and that a study-team member is not used routinely; that the witness's role differs from an interpreter's; and that the reason for witness use and the witness's presence are documented in the source notes.
national_fields.v121: Required in Slovakia when emergency enrolment is used: in Slovak, explain each Article 35 condition for the exact emergency condition and therapeutic window (not only that the trial follows Article 35); who confirms that the conditions are met and what is recorded (emergency facts, therapeutic window, why the participant could not consent, why a representative could not be reached in time, prior-objection check, enrolment decision); whether an independent physician or other safeguard is involved as stated in the protocol; the later information and consent of the participant or legal representative without undue delay; refusal and withdrawal handling for intervention, follow-up, data and samples; and that persons in custody, serving a prison sentence or held in detention are not enrolled even in emergencies (Act No. 362/2011 Coll.).

documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel K (Recruitment arrangements). Povinný dokument. Po slovensky alebo dvojjazyčne slovensky a anglicky; odpovede v tejto šablóne po slovensky. Bez podpisu účastníka alebo skúšajúceho pri predložení. Základ: šablóna EudraLex „Recruitment and informed consent procedure“ verzia 2.0 (platí pre nové predloženia časti II od 1. septembra 2026); obsah postupu je povinný, presný formulár EudraLex sa pre Slovensko dôrazne odporúča. Vyplňte polia členského štátu pre Slovensko (pozri national_fields). Pre každú populáciu s vlastným postupom súhlasu (maloletí s odôvodnenými vekovými skupinami, dospelí neschopní dať súhlas, nestranný svedok a ústny súhlas, núdzové zaradenie) vyplňte príslušný oddiel; inak uveďte, že sa neuplatňuje. Osoby vo väzbe, vo výkone trestu odňatia slobody alebo v detencii sa podľa zákona č. 362/2011 Z. z. nezaraďujú.

documents.trigger_text: Each recruitment advertisement or invitation that will be used in Slovakia.
documents.language_rule: Final Slovak wording. National guidance expects submitted patient-facing documents in English and Slovak (DECISIONS.md D1).
documents.content: Final Slovak wording; non-text formats described clearly. No promotional claims, guaranteed benefit or language that could create undue influence.
documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel K (Recruitment arrangements). Podmienečný: každý náborový inzerát alebo pozvánka používaná na Slovensku, jeden dokument na položku. Konečné slovenské znenie; netextové formáty jasne opísať. Žiadne propagačné tvrdenia, sľub prínosu ani formulácie, ktoré by mohli vyvolať neprimeraný vplyv. Bez podpisu pri predložení. Bez šablóny: návrh z protokolu a postupu náboru (K1).

documents.name_en: Participant Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form, one set per population and decision-maker
documents.language_rule: Slovak is the participant-use and controlling version. National guidance expects submitted patient-facing documents in English and Slovak; an English version, if submitted, is titled with _SK_en and kept synchronised by version and date (DECISIONS.md D1).
documents.template_status: missing: no Slovak participant templates supplied; see population_sets (every template "missing") and DECISIONS.md D15.
documents.content: Blank Slovak information sheet and consent form for each population that can enter the trial. Distinct documents whenever the information, reader, decision-maker, data subject or signature logic differs (adult, healthy volunteer, minor, legal representative, pregnancy follow-up, optional sample or data use). The information sheet may be combined with the consent form or presented as two controlled documents (DECISIONS.md D13). See population_sets.
documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel L (Subject information and informed consent form). Povinný dokument, nepodpísaný pri predložení; účastník alebo zákonný zástupca a osoba vedúca rozhovor o súhlase podpíšu a osobne datujú schválený formulár až neskôr, pred akýmkoľvek postupom špecifickým pre skúšanie. Samostatné dokumenty, keď sa líšia informácie alebo logika podpisu (dospelí, maloletí, zákonný zástupca, sledovanie tehotenstva, voliteľné použitie vzoriek). Slovenská verzia je verzia na použitie u účastníkov. Názov súboru s označením populácie a jazyka. Slovenská šablóna nebola dodaná: návrh podľa slovenských návodov (drafting_rules) alebo úprava referenčného dokumentu.

documents.trigger_text: Only when the Clinical Trials Regulation or the current Commission Q&A requires an additional participant document. Endpoint-related patient-facing documents follow the specific Part I and translation route in the Q&A (DECISIONS.md D7).
documents.language_rule: National guidance expects submitted patient-facing documents in English and Slovak.
documents.note: Do not bulk-upload every diary, patient card, questionnaire or device instruction. Keep all materials used in Slovakia translated, controlled and available for inspection even when they are not application-dossier documents.
documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel L. Podmienečný: ďalší dokument pre účastníka len vtedy, ak ho vyžaduje nariadenie (EÚ) č. 536/2014 alebo aktuálne Otázky a odpovede Komisie (marec 2026). Dokumenty súvisiace s koncovými ukazovateľmi idú osobitnou cestou časti I a prekladu (navrhovaný názov R2_Patient-facing document_<typ>_SK_sk). Národné usmernenie očakáva predložené dokumenty pre účastníkov v angličtine a slovenčine. Nepodpísané pri predložení. Nenahrávať hromadne denníky, karty, dotazníky ani návody k pomôckam.

documents.language_rule: Slovak or a bilingual version for the national file.

template.basis: Commission CV template; a document containing the same information may be used

documents.signature_rule: No separate CTIS signature (Commission Q&A, March 2026). The signed and dated source CV is retained in the Trial Master File or Investigator Site File under GCP.
documents.content: Current CV for each principal investigator showing education, relevant clinical and research experience, current position and Good Clinical Practice training. Personal details come from the investigator.
documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel M (Suitability of the investigator). Povinný dokument pre každého hlavného skúšajúceho a skúšajúce miesto. Šablóna Komisie alebo dokument s rovnakými informáciami: vzdelanie, relevantné klinické a výskumné skúsenosti, súčasná pozícia, školenie v správnej klinickej praxi. Po slovensky alebo dvojjazyčne. Bez osobitného podpisu v CTIS; podpísaný a datovaný zdrojový dokument sa uchováva v TMF alebo ISF. Asistent vypĺňa len názov skúšania a číslo EÚ skúšania; osobné údaje dodáva skúšajúci a nevymýšľajú sa.

documents.language_rule: The guides state no specific language for this item; the Slovak dossier rule applies (Act No. 362/2011 Coll., section 29a(9)); see DECISIONS.md D2.

template.basis: EudraLex declaration-of-interest template or equivalent content

documents.signature_rule: No separate signature requested in the CTIS application (Commission Q&A, March 2026). The signed and dated source declaration is kept in the controlled trial file. Check the live national instruction if the Ethics Committee republishes a revised form.
documents.content: Any financial or other interest that could affect impartiality, stated by the investigator.
documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel M (Suitability of the investigator). Povinný dokument pre každého hlavného skúšajúceho a skúšajúce miesto. Šablóna EudraLex alebo rovnocenný obsah: akýkoľvek finančný alebo iný záujem, ktorý by mohol ovplyvniť nestrannosť. Bez osobitného podpisu v žiadosti CTIS; podpísané a datované zdrojové vyhlásenie sa uchováva v riadenom spise skúšania. Ak Etická komisia zverejní revidovaný formulár, overte aktuálny národný pokyn. Asistent vypĺňa len názov skúšania a číslo EÚ skúšania; údaje o záujmoch uvádza skúšajúci sám.

documents.ctis_title: M3_List of sites and principal investigators_SK
documents.ctis_title_note: The naming guide has no example for this list; the guide places it under Suitability of the investigator, so the next free M number is proposed (DECISIONS.md D4).
documents.name_en: List of Slovak sites and principal investigators
documents.content: Every planned Slovak site, the principal investigator's name and position, and the planned number of participants per site or the total planned for Slovakia. Names, addresses and participant numbers consistent with the CTIS structured data and the site suitability forms.
documents.filled_by: sponsor (from the CTIS site data and site confirmations)
documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel M (Suitability of the investigator). Povinný zoznam všetkých plánovaných slovenských skúšajúcich miest s menom a pozíciou hlavného skúšajúceho a plánovaným počtom účastníkov na miesto alebo celkovo za Slovensko. Mená, adresy a počty musia zodpovedať štruktúrovaným údajom v CTIS a formulárom vhodnosti miesta. Bez podpisu. Údaje o miestach sa nevymýšľajú.

documents.national_template: Slovakia national site suitability form (country form provided by Slovak national guidance, updated in 2025). Not supplied: the N1 DOCX in CTIS_SK is the shared EU form (eu/templates/part-ii/N1_Site suitability.docx), which the guide does not name as the Slovak upload. Once the current national form is supplied, convert it into countries/SK/templates/part-ii (DECISIONS.md D3).
documents.signature_rule: The CTIS copy has been accepted without a signature, provided the sponsor ensures the underlying suitability confirmation is properly documented. Retain the signed source where the form and trial file require it. Verify the current form instructions before submission.
documents.content: One national form per Slovak site: facility, staff, equipment, pharmacy arrangements, emergency capability and any outsourced trial procedures needed by the protocol. Phase I or bioequivalence units demonstrate facilities, staffing and emergency capability appropriate to the protocol; emergency-enrolment trials show staff and facilities able to apply the pathway without delaying emergency care.
documents.kind_note: Becomes kind 'form' (Draft, then Check, with site fields left to the site) once the national form is supplied and converted (DECISIONS.md D3).
documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel N (Suitability of the facilities). Povinný dokument, slovenský národný formulár vhodnosti miesta pre každé skúšajúce miesto (formulár aktualizovaný v roku 2025; pred predložením overte aktuálne pokyny). Opísať zariadenie, personál, vybavenie, lekárenské zabezpečenie, schopnosť riešiť núdzové situácie a postupy zadané externe. Kópia v CTIS bola akceptovaná bez podpisu, ak zadávateľ zabezpečí riadnu dokumentáciu potvrdenia vhodnosti; podpísaný zdroj sa uchováva, ak to formulár a spis vyžadujú. Národný formulár nebol dodaný; údaje miesta vypĺňa miesto a nevymýšľajú sa.

documents.language_rule: The guides state no specific language for the certificate; the Slovak dossier rule applies (DECISIONS.md D2).
documents.signature_rule: The insurer's executed certificate is submitted as evidence; no additional sponsor signature.
documents.content: Valid insurance certificate covering trial-related injury in Slovakia for the relevant sponsor, trial and period. Current national guidance no longer requires every Slovak site to be listed on the certificate. Policy scope, territory, dates and identifiers match the application. The guides state no minimum cover.
documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel O (Proof of insurance cover or indemnification). Povinný platný poistný certifikát pokrývajúci ujmu súvisiacu so skúšaním na Slovensku pre príslušného zadávateľa, skúšanie a obdobie. Nie je potrebné uvádzať všetky slovenské miesta. Rozsah poistky, územie, dátumy a identifikátory musia zodpovedať žiadosti. Predkladá sa certifikát vystavený poisťovateľom; bez ďalšieho podpisu zadávateľa. Znenie o poistení v dokumentoch pre účastníkov musí zodpovedať certifikátu.

documents.trigger_text: Use the EudraLex participant compensation template when payments, expenses, compensation and other financial arrangements are not already stated clearly in the Participant Information Sheet (DECISIONS.md D5).
documents.content: Payments, expenses, compensation and other financial arrangements. Distinguish reimbursement of reasonable expenses from payment for time or inconvenience. State what will and will not be reimbursed (travel costs in particular), how claims work and whether payment changes after withdrawal. Minors and adults unable to consent: no financial inducement to the representative beyond compensation for expenses and loss connected with participation.
documents.filled_by: assistant; amounts and conditions only from the sponsor's sources
documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel P (Financial and other arrangements). Podmienečný: šablónu EudraLex o kompenzácii účastníkov použite, ak informácie nie sú jasne uvedené v informácii pre účastníka (odporúčanie: predkladať vždy, DECISIONS.md D5). Odlíšiť úhradu primeraných výdavkov od platby za čas alebo nepohodlie. Uviesť, čo sa uhrádza a čo nie (najmä cestovné náklady), ako sa nároky uplatňujú a či sa platba po odstúpení mení; etická komisia opakovane zistila chýbajúce informácie o úhrade cestovných nákladov. Maloletí a osoby neschopné dať súhlas: zástupcovi žiadna finančná výhoda nad náhradu výdavkov a strát súvisiacich s účasťou. Sumy a podmienky musia byť zhodné s dokumentmi pre účastníkov. Spravidla bez podpisu.

documents.ctis_section: Form (CTIS Form section, outside the Part II placeholders)
documents.ctis_title_note: The Slovakia checklist places the EudraLex GDPR statement in the CTIS Form section rather than as a duplicate Part II narrative; the naming guide gives no CTCG title for the Form-section statement ("use other CTIS upload locations"). R1_Compliance collection and use personal data_SK would apply only to a Part II upload, which the guide does not require (DECISIONS.md D6).

template.basis: EudraLex statement of compliance with Regulation (EU) 2016/679; the Member State overview reports no separate Slovakia Part II data-protection document beyond that statement

documents.signature_rule: Electronic submission by the sponsor is equivalent to signing the application.
documents.content: EudraLex GDPR compliance statement in the CTIS Form section. No national data-protection sentence is required. The Slovak Participant Information Sheet must still explain controllers, purposes, legal basis, recipients, transfers, retention, rights, withdrawal and complaint routes, consistent with this statement.

national_fields.r1_the_sponsor_declares: Not applicable in Slovakia: the guides require no national data-protection statement; remove the conditional field.

documents.filled_by: assistant; name and role of the responsible person at the sponsor from the sponsor
documents.drafting_notes_sk: Formulár CTIS (sekcia Form), nie duplicitný dokument časti II. Povinné vyhlásenie EudraLex o súlade s nariadením (EÚ) 2016/679. Prehľad Komisie neuvádza pre Slovensko žiadny osobitný dokument o ochrane údajov v časti II: podmienené pole r1_the_sponsor_declares sa neuplatňuje a odstráni sa. Elektronické predloženie zadávateľom sa rovná podpisu žiadosti. Meno a funkciu zodpovednej osoby zadávateľa dodá zadávateľ; nevymýšľať. Informácia pre účastníka musí byť s týmto vyhlásením v súlade.

documents.ctis_title: S1_Compliance collection use storage biological samples_SK
documents.trigger_text: The trial collects, stores, transfers or uses human biological samples.

template.basis: EudraLex template on compliance with applicable rules for biological samples

documents.signature_rule: Not signed at submission unless the current template expressly requires an attestation.
documents.content: Main-trial use, storage period, location, coding, transfers, destruction and any optional future use. Optional future research choices are separate from agreement to the main trial.
documents.drafting_notes_sk: CTIS časť II, oddiel S (Compliance with applicable rules for biological samples). Podmienečný: ak skúšanie odoberá, uchováva, prenáša alebo používa ľudské biologické vzorky. Opísať použitie v hlavnom skúšaní, dobu a miesto uchovávania, kódovanie, prenosy, zničenie a prípadné voliteľné budúce použitie. Voľby o budúcom výskume oddelené od súhlasu s hlavným skúšaním. Bez podpisu, pokiaľ aktuálna šablóna výslovne nevyžaduje potvrdenie. Údaje v súlade s protokolom, laboratórnym manuálom, informáciou pre účastníka a vyhlásením GDPR.

documents.ctis_section: to be confirmed (route required for the trial)
documents.ctis_title_note: The guide gives no CTIS location or title; proposed title to confirm (DECISIONS.md D8).
documents.name_en: Authorisation for a trial involving genetically modified organisms
documents.trigger_text: The trial involves genetically modified organisms (additional authorisation under Act No. 362/2011 Coll.).
documents.content: Official authorisation, prepared before the activity starts and included in the application route required for the trial.
documents.drafting_notes_sk: Podmienečný: skúšanie s geneticky modifikovanými organizmami vyžaduje dodatočné povolenie podľa zákona č. 362/2011 Z. z. Úradné povolenie pripraviť pred začatím činnosti a zaradiť do cesty žiadosti, ktorú skúšanie vyžaduje (umiestnenie v CTIS potvrdiť).

documents.ctis_section: to be confirmed (route required for the trial)
documents.ctis_title_note: The guide gives no CTIS location or title; proposed title to confirm (DECISIONS.md D8).
documents.name_en: Authorisation for planned exposure involving investigational radioactive medicinal products or precursors
documents.trigger_text: Planned exposure involving investigational radioactive medicinal products or precursors (additional authorisation under Act No. 362/2011 Coll.).
documents.content: Official authorisation, prepared before the activity starts and included in the application route required for the trial.
documents.filled_by: issuing authority (obtained by the sponsor or site)
documents.drafting_notes_sk: Podmienečný: plánovaná expozícia skúšaným rádioaktívnym liekom alebo prekurzorom vyžaduje dodatočné povolenie podľa zákona č. 362/2011 Z. z. Úradné povolenie pripraviť pred začatím činnosti a zaradiť do cesty žiadosti, ktorú skúšanie vyžaduje (umiestnenie v CTIS potvrdiť).

documents.ctis_section: N (proposed: suitability of the facilities; to be confirmed)
documents.ctis_title_note: The guide gives no CTIS location or title; it is a site authorisation, so the next free N number is proposed (DECISIONS.md D8).
documents.name_en: Transplant-centre authorisation of a site removing or transplanting human organs, tissues or cells
documents.trigger_text: A site removes or transplants human organs, tissues or cells as part of the trial (Act No. 362/2011 Coll.).
documents.content: The applicable transplant-centre authorisation held by the site; a site authorisation issue in addition to participant consent.
documents.drafting_notes_sk: Podmienečný: miesto, ktoré v rámci skúšania odoberá alebo transplantuje ľudské orgány, tkanivá alebo bunky, musí mať príslušné povolenie transplantačného centra podľa zákona č. 362/2011 Z. z. Ide o povolenie miesta popri súhlase účastníka. Pripraviť pred začatím činnosti (umiestnenie v CTIS potvrdiť).

checklist_mapping_note: One document per item of the Slovakia Part II document checklist page (checklist_item 1-12), plus the three conditional national approvals listed on the same page. The prohibited population and the submission assembly checks on that page are in population_rules and checklists/part-ii-package.json.

fields.v108: Required in Slovakia: in Slovak, state that participant documents are provided in Slovak (the Slovak version is the participant-use version); that the participant receives the information before signing and has enough time and opportunity to ask questions; that the participant or legal representative and the person conducting the consent discussion sign and personally date the approved form before any trial-specific procedure (blank and unsigned in CTIS) and that the participant receives a copy of the signed and dated form; that forms are not predated, optional choices are not completed on the participant's behalf and no later translation is used without ethics approval; and that the consent discussion is documented in the source record.
fields.v110: Required in Slovakia when adults unable to consent are included: in Slovak, describe who assesses capacity, when it is reassessed and how the result is documented (diagnosis, age, hospitalisation or disability alone do not prove incapacity); how the legally designated representative under Slovak law is identified and how their authority is verified before enrolment and retained in the site file (a caregiver or family member is not automatically the legal representative); the participant information suited to the participant's understanding and how assent is recorded; that an explicit objection of a participant who can form an opinion is respected; that the views of the person unable to consent are recorded (Act No. 576/2004 Coll.); and the participant's own consent when capacity is regained.
fields.v114: Required in Slovakia when minors are included: in Slovak, explain and justify the age and understanding bands and their documents (Slovak national guidance identifies a separate set for ages 12 to 18; capacity to understand is assessed individually); whose permission is obtained in each family situation under Slovak law and how legal authority is verified, including when two representatives sign and the legal basis where one signature is proposed; how the investigator checks whether the child can form a view; how assent and dissent are obtained and recorded (verbal assent recorded where a written form is not suitable); that explicit refusal or later dissent of a minor capable of forming an opinion is respected; and the participant's own consent with the approved adult form on turning 18.
fields.v117: Required in Slovakia when an impartial witness may be needed: in Slovak, state that a witness is used when the participant or representative cannot read the information; that a participant who understands and can consent but cannot write gives oral consent entered into a record signed by at least one witness (Slovak law); that the witness is independent of the trial, understands the language and is present for the whole discussion, and that a study-team member is not used routinely; that the witness's role differs from an interpreter's; and that the reason for witness use and the witness's presence are documented in the source notes.
fields.v121: Required in Slovakia when emergency enrolment is used: in Slovak, explain each Article 35 condition for the exact emergency condition and therapeutic window (not only that the trial follows Article 35); who confirms that the conditions are met and what is recorded (emergency facts, therapeutic window, why the participant could not consent, why a representative could not be reached in time, prior-objection check, enrolment decision); whether an independent physician or other safeguard is involved as stated in the protocol; the later information and consent of the participant or legal representative without undue delay; refusal and withdrawal handling for intervention, follow-up, data and samples; and that persons in custody, serving a prison sentence or held in detention are not enrolled even in emergencies (Act No. 362/2011 Coll.).

national_fields_note: Index of the national additions to shared forms; the same text is on each document (documents[].national_fields). Field ids are those of the shared <form>.fields.json. N1 has no national fields because the national Slovak form replaces the EU form (SK-N1).

document_kinds.form: Regulatory form the assistant answers question by question. Keep the template layout and questions unchanged.
document_kinds.participant_document: Participant- or representative-facing document written section by section, for one population.
document_kinds.third_party_template: Template completed by someone else (investigator). The assistant fills only trial fields (title, EU trial number) and leaves every other field empty for that person.
document_kinds.third_party_document: Document issued by someone else (insurer, site, sponsor, authority). Recorded as a source when received; only checked.
document_kinds.ctis_data: Information entered as structured data in CTIS; checked against the plan.

population_sets.basis: Slovakia patient information and consent guide (standard adult set); no Slovak template supplied.
population_sets.note: Standard adult Participant Information Sheet and Informed Consent Form in Slovak. Also the approved adult form for re-consent at 18 and after regained capacity.

Whenever eligibility does not depend on having the target disease (for example first-in-human, pharmacokinetic, food-effect, interaction, thorough QT, vaccine, bioequivalence). Separate documents when a study includes both patients and healthy volunteers. No shortened form because the volunteer is healthy. State directly that no medical benefit is expected; payment is not a benefit; the volunteer may withdraw without losing payment already earned.

Parent or legal-representative information and permission always; adolescent information and assent for the planned older band (commonly 12 to 17); child information and assent for younger school-age children who can understand (band defined per study and justified in K1); young children get a short verbal or visual explanation (no signed form). Re-consent at 18 with the adult form (SK-PT-main or SK-PT-healthy). All participant-use documents in Slovak.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_participant information and assent_<population>_SK_sk

population_sets.note: Article 31 conditions; legally designated representative under Slovak law with verified authority. Simplified Slovak information or assent document when the participant can understand part of the trial; assent does not replace the representative's legal consent. Approved adult form (SK-PT-main) for later use if capacity is regained.

documents.title: L1_SIS and ICF_emergency initial notice_<population>_SK_sk
documents.condition: only if it can be provided without delaying urgent care (DECISIONS.md D11)

population_sets.note: Article 35 pathway with every condition explained. A full Slovak information and consent form for the participant once capable and a full legal-representative form; a one-page emergency notice never replaces them. No verified Slovak national emergency-consent template exists; adapt the ordinary Slovak documents to the EU legal conditions. Persons in custody, serving a sentence or detained are excluded even in emergencies.

The ordinary Slovak form with a witness attestation and an oral-consent record: witness when the participant or representative cannot read; oral consent recorded and signed by at least one witness when the person can consent but cannot write. Not for limited literacy, disability or language support alone, and not for lack of capacity.

Before collecting additional pregnancy, obstetric, outcome or infant data not already covered by the main trial information. State whether pregnancy follow-up is required for safety under the main trial or a separate voluntary activity. Not a vehicle for broad consent to unrelated research or optional sampling.

Separate Slovak information and consent or authorisation form addressed to the pregnant partner; the enrolled participant cannot consent for the partner. Infant information after birth: assess who has legal authority and whether separate parent or legal-representative permission is needed.

A separate form or a clearly separate optional section (DECISIONS.md D12), with a distinct yes or no choice for each materially different optional activity, never preselected. Parent or representative versions when minors or adults unable to consent are included; the participant's own decision at adulthood or when capacity is gained if storage or use continues.

population_sets_note: population_sets list which documents a kind of population triggers; the actual populations are defined per study (playbook section 2a) and each population gets its own documents. Every template is "missing": none was supplied.

population_rules.authority: Ethics Committee established by the Ministry of Health of the Slovak Republic (national Part II assessment) and ŠÚKL; Slovak Act No. 362/2011 Coll., sections 29a(5), 29a(7) to 29a(9) and 29h; Act No. 576/2004 Coll., section 6; ŠÚKL Good Clinical Practice for investigators, section 4.8; Regulation (EU) No 536/2014 Articles 28 to 35; as recorded in the Slovakia guides reviewed 23 September 2026.
population_rules.template_status: missing: no Slovak participant templates were supplied. Every template id below is a planned id with no file ("template": "missing" in population_sets). Keys ending in _missing hold the template ids that the Germany-shaped keys (always, age_bands) would hold; the audit script checks those keys against participant_templates, which is empty.

minors.young_children: Parent or legal-representative information and permission, plus a short verbal or visual explanation suited to the child; no signed child form. Children below 12 are not excluded from information; capacity to understand is assessed individually.
minors.band_rule: Explain and justify the age bands in K1 (v114). The Ethics Committee may expect more than one child version when the age range is wide or the procedures are complex.
minors.representatives: Parent or legal representative recognised under Slovak law; whose permission is obtained in each family situation and how legal authority is verified is stated in the submission. If national law or the custody arrangement requires two representatives, plan two signature blocks; where one signature is proposed, document the legal basis and site procedure (DECISIONS.md D10).
minors.assent_dissent: Child information and assent mandatory when the child can form an opinion; assent does not replace the representative's consent; verbal assent recorded when a written form is not suitable; explicit refusal and later dissent of a minor capable of forming an opinion is respected.
minors.reconsent_at_18: SK-PT-main or SK-PT-healthy (approved adult form) promptly when participation or follow-up continues; earlier parental permission is not adult consent.
minors.payment: No financial inducement to the parent or legal representative beyond compensation for expenses and loss connected with participation.

age_bands.basis: Slovak national Part II guidance identifies a separate information and consent set for ages 12 to 18 as a typical submission document; the minors guide gives 'commonly 12 to 17'. Both mean 12 up to the 18th birthday.

age_bands.band: school-age children under 12 who can understand (lower bound defined per study)
age_bands.basis: Minors guide: child information and assent material for younger children who can understand; no fixed band (DECISIONS.md D9).

adults_without_capacity.note: SK-PT-limited-capacity when the participant can understand part of the trial. Capacity is decision-specific; legally designated representative under Slovak law with verified authority; objection of a participant who can form an opinion cannot be overridden; the participant's views recorded (Act No. 576/2004 Coll.). Participant's own consent with SK-PT-main when capacity is regained.

emergency.note: Full participant and legal-representative documents; short initial notice only if it does not delay urgent care. No national emergency-consent template exists; do not invent a national waiver form.

impartial_witness.note: Witness when the participant or representative cannot read; oral consent record signed by at least one witness when the person can consent but cannot write. A representative who cannot read needs the witness block in the representative document (DECISIONS.md D17).

pregnancy.participant: SK-PT-pregnancy only for data beyond what the main trial information covers
pregnancy.partner: SK-PT-pregnant-partner whenever partner or infant data are collected from the partner

secondary_use.note: Separate form or clearly separate optional section; separate choices for disease-related storage, genetic research, sharing with external researchers, transfer outside the EEA and re-contact, as applicable.

population_rules.prohibited_population: Slovak law prohibits enrolment of people in custody, serving a prison sentence or held in detention. No consent pathway or document is created for them (study fact population.persons_in_custody must be false).
separate_document_rules: A separate document pathway whenever the reader, decision-maker or data subject changes (Slovakia patient information and consent guide).
Patients and healthy volunteers in one study get separate information and consent documents.
Emergency enrolment cannot be created by shortening the standard form.
Optional future data or sample use, genetic research, recordings and other substudies are separate choices, not bundled with main-trial consent.
The pregnant partner receives a separate document addressed to her; the enrolled participant cannot consent on her behalf.

Re-consent: participants who turn 18 or regain capacity give their own consent with the approved adult form; new safety information that could affect willingness to continue is communicated promptly and may require revised information and re-consent.

drafting_rules: Participant documents are in Slovak: familiar words, short sentences, direct explanations; abbreviations expanded at first use; no unexplained protocol terminology or legal formulas; no wording that asks the participant to waive rights or releases the investigator, institution or sponsor from liability.

Translate the approved meaning, not only the words; replace literal translations that do not match Slovak clinical or regulatory usage; keep defined trial terms consistent across all documents; verify numbers, units, dates, probabilities, treatment names, visit frequencies, sample volumes, contraception periods and contacts sentence by sentence against the English source.

State that the activity is research; give full and short title, protocol identifier, sponsor and EU trial number where available; explain purpose, investigational treatment, comparator, randomisation, blinding and expected duration.
Separate standard care from research-only procedures; explain invasive procedures, optional activities, recording devices and anything affecting daily life.

Describe reasonably foreseeable risks and burdens, including risks to an embryo, fetus or breast-fed child; contraception, pregnancy testing, prohibited medicines and what to do if pregnancy occurs, consistent with the protocol and IB.
Do not imply personal benefit when none is expected; explain alternatives; healthy volunteers are told the trial is not intended to treat them.

Voluntariness and withdrawal: refusal does not affect care or legal rights; explain separately what withdrawal means for treatment, safety follow-up, data already collected and remaining samples; never promise deletion of all data.

Injury arrangements and insurance wording match the valid Slovakia certificate; state participant payments and reimbursement of travel and other expenses, conditions and what happens after early withdrawal (ŠÚKL 2025 deficiency).

Privacy: controllers, purposes, data categories, legal basis, recipients, source-record access by monitors, auditors and authorities, transfers, retention, rights and complaint route, consistent with the CTIS GDPR statement; consent to the trial is not a blanket GDPR consent; no claim of absolute confidentiality.

Contacts: a reachable trial medical contact (not only a generic global mailbox), a contact for participant rights or complaints, and the national Ethics Committee contact route including the telephone details required by current Slovak participant-information guidance (ŠÚKL 2025 deficiency).

Consent section: separate statements that the participant received and understood the information, had time and opportunity to ask questions, understands voluntariness, agrees to the main trial procedures, understands source-record access, received information on privacy, injury, reimbursement and withdrawal, and makes separate optional choices; signature and personal date of participant and of the person conducting the discussion; legal-representative, witness or parent blocks only in the pathway where they apply.

Optional choices: a distinct yes or no for each materially different optional activity, never preselected; no unlimited wording such as 'any research forever'; say directly if genetic analysis is planned and whether individual results are returned.
Blank documents in CTIS: no participant signatures or personal data; filename and footer carry version number, date, language, population and country.

Participant templates were not supplied; where a reference document or a later template is used, its instructions ([square-bracket] notes, italic notes, '...........' gaps) and Part II form instructions (yellow [INSERT/IF/OTHERWISE/CHOOSE/NOTE: …] labels) are drafting instructions; none may remain in a final document.

naming.convention: content/playbook/naming.md (CTCG Best Practice Guide: Naming of Documents in CTIS, v3.0, 10 February 2026)
naming.slovakia_note: Use the CTCG pattern. The Slovakia guides use descriptive names and give no national naming instruction beyond a clear population and language label in participant-document filenames. _SK_sk on participant-facing documents (_SK_en for any English companion), _SK on O1, P1, S1 and national evidence. The site list (M3), the national approvals (N<next>) and the Form-section GDPR statement carry proposed titles to confirm (DECISIONS.md D4, D6, D8).

sources_note: All Slovakia guides reviewed 23 September 2026, read 27 November 2026. '#n' after SK-PII-CHECKLIST is the item number on that page. Supplied: CTIS_SK Part II DOCX set and Slovak variable sheet (compared with the shared forms); no Slovak participant templates.

participant_templates_missing_note.status: No Slovak participant templates were supplied for Slovakia. The participant-template text file in the CTIS_SK folder is the Bulgarian set (already filed under BG) and was not used.
participant_templates_missing_note.handling: Draft each participant document from the Slovakia guides (drafting_rules, population_sets notes, checklists/participant-documents.json) with styles/base.md, or adapt it from the reference-package counterpart (based_on), until a Slovak set is supplied and split into templates/participant (DECISIONS.md D15).
